questions.question:
A train 150 m long passes a pole in 15 seconds.
Find its speed in km/h.
questions.explanation:
Speed = 150/15 = 10 m/s = 10 x 18/5 = 36 km/h.
Full solution: Quant_Sample.pdf, page 3

questions.question: Find the simple interest on ₹ 4000 at 5% per annum for 3 years.
questions.explanation:
SI = (4000 x 5 x 3)/100 = ₹ 600.
Full solution: Quant_Sample.pdf, page 3

questions.explanation:
1.2 x 0.8 = 0.96, so the net change is a 4% decrease.

questions.question: What was the profit of the company in 2022 (in ₹ crore)?
By what percent did the revenue increase from 2020 to 2022?

questions.explanation:
Profits: 30, 50, 55, 60, 70. Sum = 265, average = 265/5 = 53.

questions.question: In which year was the ratio of revenue to expenses the highest?
